Bring your expertise in AI, automation, and process transformation to UCLA Health and help build smarter, more effective healthcare operations.

UCLA Health is seeking an innovative and strategic leader to serve as Assistant/Associate Director of Intelligent Automation. In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, governance, and expansion of AI-enabled automation solutions that improve operational efficiency, quality, employee experience, and organizational performance.

As part of Performance Strategy & Analytics, you will partner with clinical, operational, technology, compliance, privacy, data governance, and analytics leaders to translate complex business needs into secure, scalable, and responsible solutions. You will also lead cross-functional delivery, establish automation priorities, measure outcomes, and build organizational capability for continuous improvement.
Develop and execute an intelligent automation roadmap aligned with organizational priorities and high-value operational needs.
Lead the assessment, design, testing, implementation, and optimization of AI-enabled automation and redesigned workflows.
Establish governance standards addressing human oversight, validation, data protection, performance monitoring, and escalation.
Advise leaders on automation strategy, solution design, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
Define and monitor measures such as return on investment, quality, productivity, cycle time, and customer experience.
Recruit, coach, and develop a high-performing team while promoting accountability, collaboration, innovation, and service excellence.

This flexible hybrid role allows for a blend of remote and on-site work, requiring presence on-site as needed based on operational requirements. Please note, travel to the “home office” location is not reimbursed. Each employee will complete a FlexWork Agreement with their manager to outline expectations and ensure mutual understanding. These arrangements are periodically reviewed and may be adjusted or terminated as necessary.
